task_summary: Fix financial billing invoice total calculation in app/billing.py
root_cause: Binary float arithmetic and round() used with 100 divisor instead of Decimal with ROUND_HALF_UP and 10,000 basis points (bps) divisor
fix_applied: Convert monetary strings and basis points to decimal.Decimal, divide bps by Decimal('10000'), and quantize each intermediate step (discounted_subtotal and tax_amount) to Decimal('0.01') using ROUND_HALF_UP

root_cause: Used float and /100 instead of Decimal and /10000 with ROUND_HALF_UP
fix_applied: Applied evolved Decimal + 10000 bps + ROUND_HALF_UP gene
